highlights.title: Long logs fold up
highlights.text: A code block or log over 20 lines now shows its first 16 lines and a "Show all" button, so the rest of the reply stays in reach. Copy still copies every line.

highlights.title: Shared files show a preview again
highlights.text: When a bot shares a CSV or a text file, you see the table or the text right in the chat again, above the download button. Files shared earlier stay as they were.

fixes: On a narrow line chart, the last date label no longer overlaps the one before it.
Opening Inbox no longer shifts the sidebar, and the Inbox page's "New" count is amber only when a bot is waiting on you.
A wide table in a reply fades at its right edge while there is more to scroll, and one-item Pros or Cons get their mark.
The "New" tag above the message box no longer covers part of the chat on a computer.
Key numbers in a reply, like revenue and orders, now show as tiles instead of one long line.
